candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly for historical figures, prominent intellectuals, and cultural icons, particularly from German-speaking history.
This feature activates on words and subwords starting with the prefix "inter-" or closely related variants.
This vector represents common Spanish abstract nouns frequently used in adverbial phrases and grammatical constructions.
This vector represents Spanish verb roots and stems commonly used for past tense or completed actions.
This vector represents traditional male given names of Germanic and Anglo-Saxon origin.
This feature vector represents concepts related to human sexuality, gender, and sexual identity.
This feature vector activates strongly on German proper nouns, names, and capitalised terms.
This vector activates strongly on sub-word tokens containing the letters "ed" (case-insensitive and across various languages).
This vector represents the string fragment 'irm' embedded within various words across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents societal domains, public spheres, and interpersonal categories.
